purpose: Bounded software/sensitivity benchmark. No real HY validation, estimate of real biological accuracy, or parameter selection.

scenarios.location_only: Nonlinear spatial fields determine projection probability. Molecular classes and gene counts are irrelevant given exact position; no incremental molecular information is built in.
scenarios.complementarity: Independent molecular classes alter nonlinear spatial radial response fields. Noisy Gamma-Poisson genes partly reveal these classes. Coupling and effect sizes are hypotheses.
scenarios.latent_unobserved: An unmeasured uniform four-state variable determines responses; measured genes and position cannot identify the state. Each target has exact observable P(Y=1|measured features)=0.5.
scenarios.batch_shift_missing: Complementarity plus animal-specific and held-out batch gene shifts, overdispersed counts/dropout, missing genes/coordinates, coordinate measurement shifts and noisy/incompletely assayed target labels. All magnitudes invented.

anchors.classification: TRAIN HY coordinate units/scale only; remaining simulation is generic
uses: coordinate centre and standard deviation in micrometres
counts of peptide-tag categories and 49-region vocabulary for disclosure only
does_not_use: A1 expression, coordinates, coefficients, scores or predictions
anchors.insufficiency: No empirical multigene assay or noise distribution. Generic simulation with a narrow TRAIN HY coordinate-scale anchor; no claim of a hypothalamic simulator.

generator.architecture: Spatial Gaussian mixtures + nonlinear radial/sinusoidal response fields + discrete molecular/hidden states; Gamma-Poisson counts, detection dropout and Bernoulli labels. Not a logistic regression generator.
generator.all_numbers_are: Synthetic sensitivity hypotheses, not estimates from HY assays.

recipe_policy: All ten families/settings fixed in the authorized development recipe are retained. Old candidate C=1 alpha=0 and two raw 1NN copies are descriptive comparison anchors. No hyperparameter grid or selection.
missingness_adapter: Fixed per-feature TRAIN median imputation (0 fallback for all-missing TRAIN feature) applied after gene log1p, then TRAIN StandardScaler; same adapter for all feature methods, no new gene/position missing indicators. Explicit extension to the complete-input frozen recipe.
training: For each target use assayed TRAIN labels only. Group-balanced 1/n_animal fit weights normalized to mean1, no class weights. q_fit uses TRAIN labels/weights only. Copy/average donors are TRAIN animals only.
evaluation: Disjoint simulated animals. Binary observed assay labels with unknown=-1 excluded; no coding unassayed targets negative. Brier on raw probabilities; log loss clipped at [1e-6,1-1e-6]. Animal-equal mean within each target, then target-equal mean.
freeze_order: Write this protocol before generating synthetic benchmark outcomes. Hash protocol/code/recipe/anchor files in STARTED. Refuse overwrite; record final file hashes. No synthetic-test-based model selection, tuning, recalibration or scenario/seed deletion.
success_criteria: Working reproducible implementation and meaningful leakage/missingness/metric tests. No required performance win or biologically interpreted pass/fail gate.
outputs: fit audit and train-only imputation/scaler values
scope_limits: One fixed seed per hypothesis gives sensitivity examples, not precise Monte Carlo performance estimates.
Scenario sample sizes, labels and couplings do not establish real-data sample size requirements or accuracy.
No complete axon geometries, synapses, causal circuits or real projection probabilities are simulated or validated.
A1 23-gene coefficients do not transfer; each synthetic panel is fit from its own synthetic TRAIN animals only.
